operation.description: One structured edit operation. 'kind' selects one of the 39 operations; the per-operation field catalog (required/optional fields and semantics) is the dnspy://docs/edit-ops resource. Unknown kinds, fields outside the operation's allowed set and missing required fields are rejected server-side with EDIT_VALIDATION_FAILED before anything is staged.
